selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main subject of the marked passage?
questions.answer: It explains the first proof in that section, which is the opening and shaping of created forms, and shows how this points to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: From what kind of starting point are these forms brought out?
questions.answer: They are brought out from a single simple substance.

questions.question: Why is the move from one substance to many forms important for the argument?
questions.answer: Because it shows that great diversity can come from one will and one power.

questions.question: How is the earth’s living world presented as even more striking than that first image?
questions.answer: It is shown as containing hundreds of thousands of species, each with its own carefully formed appearance.

questions.question: How does Allah’s complete knowledge support the argument about unity?
questions.answer: Since nothing is hidden from Him, He can shape every being perfectly without confusion, which supports the idea of one all-knowing Creator.

questions.question: Why does the passage avoid a long detailed discussion here?
questions.answer: Because it says that this topic has already been explained in detail elsewhere.

questions.question: Why can this deed not belong to many different agents, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because the work is universal and all-embracing, so it must belong to the One who governs the whole cosmos.

questions.question: What do those sciences, as presented here, make clear about the cause of living forms?
questions.answer: They make clear that such universal and artistic formation cannot come from anything less than the one all-powerful Creator.

questions.question: Which details in human and animal formation are meant to block the idea of accident?
questions.answer: The equilibrium, clarity, order, and absence of confusion or mistake.

questions.question: How does the passage define comprehensiveness as theological evidence?
questions.answer: It treats comprehensiveness as a mark of unity because a power that embraces all things cannot be divided among rivals.

questions.question: What title is given to the first truth in the marked passage?
questions.answer: It is called the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What example from the larger universe is used first to explain this opening of forms?
questions.answer: The passage points to the many beings in the cosmic garden, like flowers, each given its own ordered shape and identity.

questions.question: How does the passage present the speed and unity of this creative act?
questions.answer: It says the act occurs together, instantly, and through one deed.

questions.question: In the earthly example, what is special about the forms of animate species?
questions.answer: Each species has its own measured and ornamented form.

questions.question: What two main ideas do the cited verses join together?
questions.answer: They join Allah’s total knowledge with His power to form as He wills.

questions.question: Why are scientific disciplines mentioned here?
questions.answer: They are used to show that careful study of life also points toward comprehensive wisdom and power in creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say no one besides Allah could undertake?
questions.answer: No one besides the One who is unique, absolutely powerful, and fully seeing and acting in all things could carry out this universal shaping of forms.

questions.question: How does the same power operating all over the earth strengthen the argument?
questions.answer: It shows that one wisdom and one artistry are active everywhere, which supports unity rather than partnership.

questions.question: What is the connection between the administration of the cosmos and the making of individual forms?
questions.answer: The passage says only the One who runs the whole cosmos can also give each being its proper form.

questions.question: What broader lesson is drawn from the earlier nineteen truths?
questions.answer: They are said to point to the Creator’s existence and also to His unity because of how broadly they apply.

questions.question: In one sentence, what claim does the passage make about the formation of living things?
questions.answer: The shaping of countless living forms is a direct and powerful sign that their Maker is one.

questions.question: What is significant about the timing and spread of this opening?
questions.answer: It happens together, across many places, and in one instant through one act.

questions.question: About how many species of animate beings are mentioned on the earth?
questions.answer: About four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: What example from the cosmos helps the reader imagine the process?
questions.answer: The emergence of many beings like flowers in a vast garden.
